notes: Roblox Studio and Luau are evergreen: Roblox ships them, so they cannot be pinned. Pin every community tool in the project's rokit.toml and every package in wally.toml. Versions read from GitHub releases and the Wally index on 2026-11-15; see skills/roblox-setup/references/versions.md.

primitives.name: Roblox Studio
primitives.install: Download from https://create.roblox.com/download and sign in
primitives.note: Evergreen; record the Studio version shown in Help > About in the setup report

primitives.name: Roblox Studio MCP server (built in)
primitives.install: Studio: Assistant > ... > Manage MCP Servers > Enable Studio as MCP server, then Quick connect > Claude Code. Manual: Windows command `cmd.exe /c %LOCALAPPDATA%\Roblox\mcp.bat`; macOS command `/Applications/RobloxStudio.app/Contents/MacOS/StudioMCP` (stdio)
primitives.note: Replaces the archived Roblox/studio-rust-mcp-server (archived 2026-04-03). Adds open_cloud_invoke for Open Cloud calls without an API key, gated by per-game MCP Permissions

primitives.name: Script Sync (built in)
primitives.install: Studio: File > Beta Features > Script Sync, restart, then right-click a service > Script Sync > Sync to
primitives.note: Studio-native file sync for scripts and folders only. Beta status per the coding-harness guide

primitives.name: Rokit (toolchain manager)
primitives.install: Install per the Rokit README, then `rokit install` in the project (reads rokit.toml)

primitives.name: Rojo
primitives.install: rokit add rojo-rbx/rojo@7.7.1  then  rojo plugin install
primitives.note: Required for the Rojo workflows; not needed for the Script Sync workflow

primitives.name: Wally (package manager)
primitives.install: rokit add UpliftGames/wally@0.3.2  then  wally init  and  wally install

primitives.name: StyLua (formatter)
primitives.install: rokit add JohnnyMorganz/StyLua@2.6.0

primitives.name: selene (linter)
primitives.install: rokit add Kampfkarren/selene@0.32.0

primitives.name: Luau Language Server
primitives.install: VS Code or Cursor extension JohnnyMorganz.luau-lsp plus the Luau Language Server Companion Studio plugin; CLI analyzer: rokit add JohnnyMorganz/luau-lsp@1.70.1

primitives.name: Lune (standalone Luau runtime)
primitives.install: rokit add lune-org/lune@0.11.1

primitives.name: Jest Lua (tests)
primitives.install: wally.toml [dev-dependencies]: Jest = "jsdotlua/jest@3.10.0", JestGlobals = "jsdotlua/jest-globals@3.10.0"
primitives.note: Runs only inside Roblox. Needs FFlagEnableLoadModule=true for debug.loadmodule

primitives.name: run-in-roblox
primitives.install: rokit add rojo-rbx/run-in-roblox@0.3.0
primitives.note: Last release 2020; still the documented Jest Lua CLI runner. Prefer Open Cloud Luau Execution for CI

primitives.name: React Lua
primitives.install: wally.toml: react = "jsdotlua/react@17.2.1", react-roblox = "jsdotlua/react-roblox@17.2.1"

primitives.name: Promise
primitives.install: wally.toml: Promise = "evaera/promise@4.0.0"

primitives.name: ProfileStore (player data)
primitives.install: Copy the module from the GitHub repo or its Creator Store listing; not in the Wally index under madstudioroblox/profilestore

primitives.name: rbx-merge
primitives.install: Per the rbx-merge README, with the setup in the Fully managed Rojo guide
primitives.note: Repo root has no license file (checked 2026-11-15), so no license is granted; ask the author before use in a commercial project.

primitives.name: Open Cloud
primitives.install: Create an API key at https://create.roblox.com/dashboard/credentials with only the scopes needed; store it as the ROBLOX_API_KEY secret

primitives.name: Roblox docs for agents
primitives.install: Point the agent at llms.txt, the engine index (https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/llms.txt), and the search API (https://create.roblox.com/docs/api/search?q=<question>). Add .md to any docs URL for Markdown

primitives.name: rbxcloud (Open Cloud CLI)
primitives.install: rokit add Sleitnick/rbxcloud@0.17.0
primitives.note: Community CLI; last release 2025-03-23. Per its README, supports v1 Assets, Data Stores, Messaging, and Place Publishing, and v2 Groups, Universes, Places, Subscriptions, Inventory, User Notifications, User, User Restrictions, and Luau Execution. Not supported: v2 Data Stores, Instances, and Creator Store.

primitives.name: roblox-ts
primitives.install: npm i -D roblox-ts@3.0.0  (only for teams that want TypeScript instead of Luau)
